purpose: Run a small author-compatible GPT-2 Medium pilot on the eight frozen CNN/DailyMail contexts before the full Figure-3 sweep.

payload.note: Twenty-four bits is a technical pilot budget chosen before GPT-2 Medium execution. It is not asserted to be the undocumented message length used by the original Figure-3 batch driver and is not a frozen full-sweep sampling choice.

execution.load_strategy: Load GPT-2 Medium once with the slow tokenizer plus legacy cache adapter for Bins/Huffman, release it, then load the raw reference GPT-2 Medium with the default tokenizer for Arithmetic.

success_criteria: all 32 author-compatible calls complete without exception
each decoded stream starts with the exact 24-bit useful payload
each generated sequence is non-empty and the final generated token satisfies the pinned reference sentence-finish predicate
the pinned Harvard checkout remains byte-for-byte unmodified
diagnostics_not_hard_failures: sender token IDs may differ from retokenized text IDs when the author BPE-repair path still recovers the payload
an earlier sentence-finish token may appear during payload embedding because the public finish_sent flag only forces greedy completion after the message is consumed
pilot metrics are technical diagnostics and must not be reported as final Figure-3 reproduction points
